laura (vendor-liaison): Quick check 1: vendor emailed: MI300 microcode might land two weeks later than promised. We need a regional announce fallback.
ben (partnerships): Propose NA first, EU +10d, APAC +21d. If MI300 late, announce H100/H200/B200 and mark MI300 as 'pending validation'.
michael (eng): Tech note: Gaudi images are green but need OCI tag refresh; MI300 requires microcode + driver sync. Risk if microcode misses: perf delta ~8%.
anya (marketplace): Marketplace needs 14 days for verified images. If MI300 is pending, we can soft-list SKU placeholders with a "coming soon" flag 7 days prior.
ryan (solutions): For SIs, publish two perf artifacts: nominal and "compat mode". That helps integrators tune expectations.
press-ops: Messaging: avoid "delay" language. Use "staged availability" and clearly list regional gating criteria.
laura (vendor-liaison): Action items: vendor ETA update by Apr 21 (laura), marketplace placeholders by Apr 18 (anya), perf artifacts by Apr 19 (ryan), eng gating checklist Apr 18 (michael).
ben (partnerships): Good. If vendor missing Apr 21, we finalize NA/EU announce without MI300 and stagger APAC. I'll draft partner packet next. :thumbsup:
